description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'EditorInfoUtil' that provides methods to inspect and dump the contents of an 'EditorInfo' object for debugging or informational purposes. It includes methods for dumping input types, IME options, and capital modes.

classes.name: EditorInfoUtil
classes.description: A utility class for dumping contents of an EditorInfo object for debugging, not intended to be instantiated.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the EditorInfo object, or 'null' if the object is null.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Appends detailed information about the EditorInfo object to a StringBuilder.

methods.name: dumpInputType
methods.description: Appends a human-readable description of the input type to a StringBuilder.

methods.name: dumpImeOptions
methods.description: Appends a human-readable description of the IME options to a StringBuilder.

methods.name: dumpCapsMode
methods.description: Appends a human-readable description of the capitalization mode to a StringBuilder.
